review_candidates.title: Data Engineer (Finance)

remote_eligibility.note: Generic company words such as 'worldwide' do not count without remote-work context.

review_candidates.description_excerpt: Experience start-up at scale. This role sits at the intersection of finance, technology, and engineering, and will be responsible for building and maintaining scalable data solutions that support financial reporting and operational decision-making. This is a hands-on role with significant ownership, where you will work closely with finance and operations teams to improve data visibility, accuracy, and efficiency across the organization. Primary Responsibilities: Design, build, and maintain data pipelines and applications using Microsoft Azure and Microsoft Fabric Develop and optimize SQL data models to support financial reporting and analysis
review_candidates.full_review_rule: Open the full record for any possible IT fit or any ambiguity; title alone cannot reject.
